title: NormaWatch input
description: Choose the BOE publication dates and optional filters. Only Section I (general provisions) is read.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First BOE date to read, not after today (Europe/Madrid). Empty means today.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last BOE date to read, at most 31 days after the from date. Empty means the from date.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Keep only items whose department contains one of these texts (case-insensitive, plain text). At most 50 entries.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep only items whose title contains one of these texts (case-insensitive, plain text). At most 50 entries.

onlyNew.title: Only new items
onlyNew.description: Skip items already returned by earlier runs (useful for scheduled runs).

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Pause between two requests to the BOE. At least 500.
